newsitem.title: USA: Chancellor sees delay in results.
newsitem.headline: Chancellor sees delay in results.

text.p: Sydney-based Chancellor Group Inc said on Monday it expects to file its 10-K report for the year ended July 31, 1996, and the first quarter ended October 31, 1996, within the next four to eight weeks.

The company said the delay in reporting earnings is a result of a complicated structure that involves different accounting treatments used by separate auditors for all of the companies of which Chancellor holds controlling interests.

"Chancellor's broad-based, international holdings and numerous acquisitions have presented a prodigious and unexpected challenge to the various auditing firms working to produce the final results for its first full year of operation," said President and Chief Executive Neil Green.

The holding company said its operations include a U.S.-based oil and gas subsidiary, an Australian electronic and multimedia company, a specialty forest and lumber company in Fiji, and other Australian, Aruban and U.S. based operations.
Chancellor Group is based in Sydney and has executive offices in New York and Las Vegas.
